repo: https://github.com/kirodotdev/Kiro (issue tracker only - Kiro product source is NOT public)
surfaces: IDE (VS Code fork, Windows/macOS/Linux), CLI (kiro-cli, TUI + headless), Web, Mobile, Crew. Local activity logs exist for IDE and CLI only; Web/Mobile and CLI --cloud runs are server-side and invisible locally.
binaries: kiro-cli.exe (CLI, TUI + `kiro-cli chat --no-interactive`); Kiro.exe (IDE); also `kiro` on PATH per docs. Discodex Provider::from_executable must add "kiro-cli" (currently only "kiro" maps).

paths: %USERPROFILE%\.kiro\sessions\<workspaceKey>\sess_<uuid>\session.json (IDE/V3 metadata: id, modelId, workspacePaths, createdAt, lastModifiedAt, title, agentMode, status)

%USERPROFILE%\.kiro\sessions\cli\<sessionId>.json (CLI V2 header: session_id, cwd, created_at, title, session_created_reason, session_state.rts_model_state.model_info.model_id/model_name, session_state.conversation_metadata.user_turn_metadatas[])
%LOCALAPPDATA%\Kiro-Cli\data.sqlite3 (CLI headless, table conversations_v2(key, conversation_id, value, created_at, updated_at); value is JSON with history[]) - not tail-friendly
storage.format: JSONL (one JSON object per line) for the two transcript stores; JSON-per-file for session.json/<uuid>.json and the globalStorage .chat/execution JSONs; SQLite for data.sqlite3 (conversations_v2) and the VS Code state.vscdb.
storage.append_semantics: The two JSONL transcript stores ARE append-only and live, so the existing Discodex LogTailer works unchanged. IDE/V3: the engine persists one line per action state change (awaiting_approval -> executing -> completed/failed/denied, via acp-server.js persistAction) with monotonically increasing RFC3339 timestamps. CLI V2: the client appends the reply as it streams, several AssistantMessage records sharing one message_id. NOT append-only: the SQLite conversations_v2 row holds the whole conversation and is rewritten every turn (upstream issue #11960: 'held open by the process and written LIVE on every session turn'); the globalStorage .chat files are whole-file JSON rewritten in place.
storage.session_file_naming: IDE/V3: sessions/<workspaceKey>/sess_<uuid>/{session.json,messages.jsonl}; CLI V2: sessions/cli/<sessionId>.{json,jsonl} (session id = UUID, also the file stem); CLI V3 index: session-index/<workspaceKey>.jsonl. The <workspaceKey> folder is an ENCODED path key, not the plain project name - the authoritative project path is session.json.workspacePaths[0] (IDE/V3) or the sidecar cwd (CLI V2).

fields.project: RECOVERABLE. IDE/V3: session.json.workspacePaths[0]; CLI V2: sidecar .json `cwd`; SQLite: row `key`; globalStorage: encoded workspace folder.
fields.model: RECOVERABLE but churn-prone. IDE/V3: session.json.modelId (often the internal "auto"), plus payload.reasoningModelId (e.g. "qdev::auto") and a `model` key in flat lines (e.g. "big-pickle"). CLI V2: sidecar session_state.rts_model_state.model_info.model_id / .model_name (e.g. "claude-sonnet-4-5" / "Claude Opus 4.8"). Must be filtered with a strict charset allowlist and internal ids (auto/agent/qdev) dropped.
fields.file_basename: RECOVERABLE from tool args only (never from the transcript body). args.path (fs_write, fs_append, str_replace, read_file, write, read), args.targetFile (delete_file), args.operations[].path (read; skip mode=="Directory").
fields.tool_activity: RECOVERABLE. IDE/V3: payload.toolName + payload.args + payload.status. CLI V2: content[].data.name + content[].data.input for parts of kind "toolUse". Tool vocabulary: execute_bash, execute_pwsh, execute_cmd, shell, fs_write, fs_append, str_replace, read_file, fs_read, delete_file, write, read.
fields.phase: RECOVERABLE. IDE/V3: payload.type turn_start / turn_end (stopReason=end_turn), usage_summary (elapsedTime, status), session_event (category=session_pause). CLI V2: kind=="Prompt" starts a turn; kind=="ToolResults"/"AssistantMessage" continue it. Maps to Discodex Phase::Thinking / Phase::RunningTools plus Completed on turn_end.
fields.timestamps: RECOVERABLE. IDE/V3: top-level `timestamp`, RFC3339 with milliseconds ("2026-10-08T20:32:46.927Z"). CLI V2: data.meta.timestamp as FLOAT SECONDS (e.g. 1785600005.42) - note events::line_timestamp_ms only looks for top-level timestamp/created_at/time/createdAt and will NOT find this nested field, so the Kiro parser must read it and multiply by 1000. SQLite: created_at/updated_at are unix milliseconds, user.timestamp is RFC3339 or null.

parser_strategy: Add Provider::Kiro branch in events::parse_line_for that dispatches on the record shape (no new ParsedEvent variants needed). IDE/V3 shape (a `payload` object is present): payload.type=="user" -> TaskStarted{started_at_ms from top-level `timestamp`}; payload.type=="assistant" with operationType=="Reasoning" -> Thinking{reasoning:None} (content is literally "..." and the real text sits in reasoningSignature - never publish it); payload.type=="assistant" with operationType=="Say" -> Thinking{reasoning:None} (never publish content); payload.type=="tool_call" -> only act when status=="completed" (TrackedToolStarted{call_id: payload.toolCallId, activity}) or status=="failed" (TrackedToolStarted+TrackedToolFinished); status "awaiting_approval"/"executing"/"denied" -> emit nothing, because the engine writes one line per action state and acting on all of them double-publishes; payload.type=="tool_result" -> TrackedToolFinished{call_id: payload.toolCallId}; payload.type=="turn_end" -> Completed; session_metadata/usage_summary/session_event/pending_interaction/interaction_resolved/session_start -> nothing (session_start holds the system prompt, pending_interaction holds the approval question). Flat older-IDE shape (no `payload`, has `role`) -> user => TaskStarted, assistant => TerminalCandidate. CLI V2 shape (a `kind` string is present): kind=="Prompt" -> TaskStarted{started_at_ms = data.meta.timestamp * 1000 (float seconds)}; kind=="AssistantMessage" -> for each content part: kind=="text" -> Thinking{None}; kind=="toolUse" -> TrackedToolStarted{call_id: part.data.toolUseId, activity built from part.data.name + part.data.input}; kind=="ToolResults" -> for each part with kind=="toolResult" -> TrackedToolFinished{call_id: part.data.toolUseId}. Tool->label: execute_bash/execute_pwsh/execute_cmd/shell go through the existing classify_tool shell branch (so `cargo test` -> "Running Rust tests"); fs_write/fs_append/write/str_replace/delete_file -> "Editing files"; read_file/fs_read/read -> "Reading project files". File basename: read args.path / args.targetFile / args.operations[].path (skip mode=="Directory") - extract_file_basename in events.rs currently lacks "targetFile" and "operations", so add a small Kiro-specific extractor rather than changing shared behaviour. Model: parse from the sidecar only, with the same strict charset allowlist as deepseek_model_label, dropping internal ids (auto/agent/qdev/qdev::auto). Sidecar (session.json / <uuid>.json) is a whole-file JSON document, not line-delimited, so it cannot go through LogTailer: add provider::is_session_metadata(provider, path) and, in main.rs's WorkerEvent::Paths branch, read the ~300-byte file with std::fs::read_to_string and feed it to a new events::parse_document_for(provider, doc) returning SessionMetadata{project,cwd} + AgentDetected{agent}.
discodex_plan: PROVIDER: Provider::Kiro already exists in src/provider.rs:15 - it needs has_session_tracking() -> true, default_activity() moved from the "Working with AI editor" group to "Working with coding agent", and from_executable must add "kiro-cli" (the real binary; today only "kiro" maps). logo_url is already https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@lobehub/icons-static-png@1.97.0/dark/kiro-color.png - VERIFIED HTTP 200, image/png, 5553 bytes (kiro.png also exists at the same pinned path, 4750 bytes). SESSION SOURCE: add SessionSource { provider: Kiro, root: home.join(".kiro").join("sessions") } -> %USERPROFILE%\.kiro\sessions. NOTE: watcher.rs::collect_logs skips child directories starting with '.', but only below the root, so the root's children (cli/, <workspaceKey>/) are fine - still assert it in a test. IS_SESSION_LOG (path-aware, one rule for both layouts): filename "messages.jsonl" AND parent dir name starts with "sess_" -> true; filename ends with ".jsonl" AND parent dir name == "cli" -> true; everything else false (excludes session.json, session-index/*.jsonl, and any other *.jsonl). WATCHER/MAIN CHANGES: watcher.rs needs NO change for the transcripts - they are append-only line-delimited JSONL, exactly what LogTailer handles. main.rs needs one new branch (sidecar document read) as described in parser_strategy. state.rs needs NO change - the existing ParsedEvent set covers every Kiro signal. SQLITE PATH: deliberately deferred - it would need a NEW dependency (rusqlite with the `bundled` feature compiles SQLite C, ~+1-2 min build, or libsqlite3-sys requiring a system SQLite), read-only/immutable access because the file is held open by the running kiro-cli (upstream issue #11960), and POLLING instead of tailing because the row is rewritten every turn. IDE GLOBALSTORAGE (state.vscdb / *.chat): not needed for the rich path and requires the same sqlite crate; the .chat files are whole-file JSON rewritten in place, so they are unusable with a line tailer. UNIT TESTS TO ADD: (1) kiro_ide_tool_call_maps_to_safe_activity - a real-shape tool_call record yields TrackedToolStarted{label:"Running command", file:"main.rs", language:"Rust"} and the full path plus raw command are absent; (2) kiro_ide_never_forwards_message_text - user/assistant/session_start(system prompt)/pending_interaction(approval question)/tool_result records produce no event containing any secret string, and reasoningSignature never leaks - MANDATORY privacy test; (3) kiro_cli_jsonl_handles_streamed_pieces_and_tool_use - two AssistantMessage records sharing one message_id plus a toolUse part plus a ToolResults record yield the correct started_at_ms (float seconds * 1000), a TrackedToolStarted with the file basename, and a TrackedToolFinished with the same call_id, while the assistant text is not forwarded; (4) kiro_sidecar_yields_project_and_model_only - session.json and the CLI sidecar yield SessionMetadata + AgentDetected and the session `title` is not published; (5) kiro_session_log_matcher_accepts_only_transcripts - sess_x/messages.jsonl true, cli/uuid.jsonl true, session.json false, session-index/ws.jsonl false, sess_x/other.jsonl false, and Provider::Kiro.has_session_tracking() is true; (6) kiro_tool_call_states_are_deduplicated - awaiting_approval + executing + completed lines produce exactly ONE TrackedToolStarted and a `denied` line produces none.

risks: DOCS vs IMPLEMENTATION DRIFT: the official session-management docs say the CLI stores sessions in a 'SQLite database in ~/.kiro/' and 'Auto-save to database only (not files)', while three independent readers document file-based stores (sessions/cli/*.jsonl and sessions/<ws>/sess_*/messages.jsonl) and place the SQLite DB in the platform data dir. Fail safe: implement the file-based stores first, treat the DB as optional, and never guess a shape.

SIDE-CAR DEPENDENCY: the project path and model id are NOT in the transcripts - they live in session.json / <uuid>.json, which are whole-file JSON documents the line tailer cannot parse. This needs a small new mechanism (a sidecar read), not a rewrite, but it IS a change to main.rs. Never recover the project from the workspace folder name: it is an encoded path key, not the plain folder name.
TWO SHAPES IN ONE FILE: current IDE builds write the `payload` wrapper, older builds wrote flat {role,content} into the same messages.jsonl. Support both; ignore anything else.

DUPLICATE TOOL EVENTS: the V3 engine writes one tool_call line per action state (awaiting_approval, executing, completed, failed, denied). Acting on all of them double-publishes. Only act on completed/failed, and key on toolCallId.

TIMESTAMP UNITS DIFFER: CLI V2 uses float SECONDS at data.meta.timestamp (nested, so events::line_timestamp_ms will not find it), IDE/V3 uses top-level RFC3339. Also the CLI timestamps only the Prompt record, so a reply inherits the prompt's time.

MODEL ID CHURN: modelId is frequently the internal 'auto'; real ids appear as model_name/model_id/reasoningModelId ('qdev::auto', 'big-pickle', 'claude-sonnet-4-5'). Apply a strict charset allowlist and drop internal ids, or wrong strings reach Discord.

TOOL NAME CHURN: execute_bash/execute_pwsh/execute_cmd/shell, fs_write/fs_append/str_replace/read_file/fs_read/delete_file, write/read. Keep an allowlist plus a generic fallback; never echo an unknown tool name verbatim.

FILE-ARG EXTRACTION GAP: events::extract_file_basename covers path/file/file_path/filepath/AbsolutePath/TargetFile/SearchPath/... but NOT Kiro's camelCase 'targetFile' nor the 'operations' array - a Kiro-specific extractor is required, and Directory-mode entries must be skipped.

SQLITE COST: reading data.sqlite3 or state.vscdb would add a new dependency (rusqlite bundled = compiles SQLite C, ~+1-2 min build; libsqlite3-sys = system SQLite), needs read-only access while kiro-cli holds the file open, and requires polling because the row is rewritten every turn. Defer; it is not needed for the rich path.

THE .kiro DOT-DIRECTORY: watcher.rs::collect_logs skips child directories starting with '.', which is fine because the root's children are cli/ and <workspaceKey>/, but this must be covered by a test so a future root change does not silently disable Kiro.
CLOUD SESSIONS ARE INVISIBLE: kiro-cli --cloud, Kiro Web and Kiro Mobile store sessions server-side, so those runs will produce no local presence. This is a coverage gap, not a bug.

NOTHING IS ENCRYPTED AND NO AUTH TOKEN IS NEEDED for these files - they are plain JSON/JSONL owned by the user. The only opaque field is reasoningSignature, a signed blob whose plaintext is literally '...'.

IDE GLOBALSTORAGE IS A POOR SOURCE: the .chat/execution JSON files are whole-file rewrites and the kiro.kiroagent store grows unbounded (upstream issue #5727 reports ~38GB), so it should not be used for live activity even though it is parseable.
confidence: high on the file-based JSONL stores (three independent open-source readers plus a committed fixture taken from a live logged-in kiro-cli 2.22.0 install, and Kiro's own Windows paths confirmed in upstream issues #11585 and #11960); medium on which CLI engine is the current default (the official docs say the CLI stores sessions in a SQLite database under ~/.kiro/ while the readers document the file-based stores - a docs/implementation drift worth guarding against); low on the exact globalStorage .chat inner schema, which no verified sample covers.
summary: Kiro is viable at the full "rich" level. It is NOT cloud-only: the IDE (a VS Code fork) and the CLI both write local, unencrypted, APPEND-ONLY, LINE-DELIMITED JSONL transcripts under %USERPROFILE%\.kiro\sessions - the exact shape the existing Discodex LogTailer already handles, so watcher.rs needs no change. The IDE and CLI V3 store a directory per session: sessions\<workspaceKey>\sess_<uuid>\messages.jsonl plus a sibling session.json holding id, modelId, workspacePaths and timestamps. The CLI V2/classic TUI stores sessions\cli\<sessionId>.jsonl plus a sibling <sessionId>.json holding cwd and session_state.rts_model_state.model_info.model_id. Every richness field is recoverable WITHOUT shipping conversation text: project from session.json.workspacePaths[0] (or the sidecar cwd), model from session.json.modelId or the sidecar model_id, current-file basename from tool-call args (args.path, args.targetFile, args.operations[].path), normalized tool activity from payload.toolName (execute_bash/execute_pwsh/fs_write/fs_append/str_replace/read_file/delete_file) or the CLI's content[].data.name, phase from turn_start/turn_end, and the elapsed timer from the first user record's timestamp. Two non-tail-friendly stores exist and are deliberately out of scope: the headless CLI's SQLite DB (%LOCALAPPDATA%\Kiro-Cli\data.sqlite3, table conversations_v2, row rewritten every turn) and the IDE's globalStorage .chat JSON-per-file mirror (%APPDATA%\Kiro\User\globalStorage\kiro.kiroagent). The only extra machinery Discodex needs beyond the existing contract is a way to read the small sidecar JSON documents (session.json / <uuid>.json), because they are whole-file JSON rather than line-delimited and cannot go through the LogTailer. Kiro's product source is not public, so the evidence is Kiro's own docs, Kiro's own GitHub issues (Windows paths), and three independent open-source readers (two in Rust).
